mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that can potentiate adrenergic effects; nortriptyline is a tricyclic antidepressant with noradrenergic activity that may enhance sympathomimetic responses and increase risk of hypertension and arrhythmias.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; use brimonidine ophthalmic with caution in patients on nortriptyline; consider alternative topical agents if hypertensive episodes occur.
